title: Travel level 3

artwork.concept: A raised paved sidewalk and curb beside a narrow strip of street; the broad pedestrian surface dominates, with no cars, crossing stripes or signs.

One single zebra crossing connecting opposite sidewalks across a straight road, seen from above; parallel white stripes run along the road direction and are arranged side by side across its width. No vehicles, words or traffic lights.
artwork.feedback: The zebra crossing isn't across the road.

artwork.concept: One freestanding traffic signal with three vertically arranged circular red, amber and green lenses; no road scene, car, lettering or arrows.
One outdoor fountain with a clearly visible central upward water jet and round basin; no swimming-pool ladder, people or surrounding park.
One empty park bench with a long seat and backrest wide enough for several people; no tree, shelter, people or snowy scene.
One small church with a bell tower, arched entrance and simple cross on the roof; no museum columns, statue display, lettering or people.

One metro train inside a clearly visible underground tunnel with tiled platform edge; the tunnel distinguishes the system from an ordinary open-air train. No readable station name, letter M, people or separate entrance-stair subject.
One complete motorcycle with motor, fuel tank, saddle and two wheels visible; no rider, bicycle pedals, helmet as a second subject or background.
A compact marked parking area seen obliquely from above, with three clear parking bays and one small parked car; emphasize the parking layout, with no letter P, words or prices.
One small fuel station canopy and two recognizable fuel pumps with hoses; no car as a main subject, brands, prices or readable text.
One protective motorcycle helmet with an open face area, clear visor and chin guard; no rider, motorcycle, hat brim or written logo.
A clearly fastened three-point seat belt across one empty car seat, with its diagonal shoulder strap, lap strap and buckle visible; no car exterior, person or lettering.
One whole red apple with a stem and green leaf; reuse the approved standalone apple.
artwork.inspection: Visually inspected: one standalone red apple, stem and leaf; suitable for manzana.

artwork.concept: One ripe yellow dessert banana, gently curved with a short stem; no other fruit, basket, cooked plantain or plate.
artwork.inspection: Visually inspected approved standalone banana; earlier audit mistakenly overlooked this asset.
artwork.feedback: For plátano, I'm fairly sure there's an existing banana image.

One empty collared button-front shirt with long sleeves, shown alone and unfolded; no person, tie, jacket or lettering.

One simple broad-brimmed sun hat with a crown and plain band; no head, helmet, culturally exaggerated decoration or lettering.
One empty casual jacket with a clearly visible front zipper, standing collar and two pockets; no person, shirt underneath or lettering.
One empty one-piece swimsuit with two shoulder straps and clear leg openings; no person, shorts, pool or other garments.
Snow-capped mountain peaks; reuse the approved isolated mountain illustration.
artwork.inspection: Visually inspected: isolated snow-capped mountain peaks; suitable for generic montaña despite showing two peaks.

artwork.concept: A winding river between green banks; reuse the approved river illustration.
artwork.inspection: Visually inspected: winding blue river between green banks, with no unrelated main subject.

artwork.concept: One broad enclosed freshwater lake with an irregular natural shoreline visibly wrapping around it; no straight tiled edges, ladder, winding river, beach umbrella or boat.
One compact green island completely surrounded by blue water, seen from an elevated angle; water must be visible around every side, with no mainland, beach umbrella or boat.
A group of leafy trees forming a compact grove; reuse the approved forest illustration.
artwork.inspection: Visually inspected: five leafy trees form a grove; suitable for bosque and already transparent.

artwork.concept: One clearly vertical waterfall pouring over a low rocky ledge into a small pool, with a few white splash shapes; no mountain peaks, bridge, fountain jet or surrounding forest.
One soft rectangular sleeping pillow with a simple seam and gentle corner folds; no bed, blanket, person or lettering.

artwork.feedback: The blanket looks like a scarf.

artwork.concept: One handheld hair dryer with handle, nozzle and short visible power lead; no person, hairbrush, charger or lettering.

artwork.feedback: The paper is tearing at a weird angle.

artwork.concept: One simple hair comb with a straight spine and a single row of clearly separated teeth; no hairbrush, person or scissors.

choiceReviewNotes.note: The metro picture must show an underground tunnel/platform. Exclude metro versus the generic train and train-station pictures when packs combine; all can depict rail travel.
Keep the pedestrian sidewalk and zebra crossing distinct from the level 2 street scene. Review these three together at 145px before choosing distractors.
The park and bus-stop pictures already contain a bench; exclude banca versus those scenes. The new banca must read as a long multi-person seat, distinct from silla.
Keep the bell tower and roof cross distinct from the museum portico/statue; no generic civic building can serve as both pictures.
The parking picture includes a small car to establish scale/use. Exclude parking-lot versus car/taxi if the vehicle makes either answer defensible.
Use the belt and empty seat as the whole subject, not a car exterior. Review against the vehicle cards before activation.
The approved market contains apples and bananas among its produce. Exclude affected fruit/market pairs when the same fruit is clearly present.
The approved menu has a taco pictogram. Exclude taco/menu as picture distractors; retain the full menu booklet as the primary menu subject.
The approved bridge includes a river. Exclude río/puente as picture distractors.
A lake needs an enclosed irregular natural shoreline. Keep it distinct from a winding river and the rectangular tiled pool; review together at 145px.
Show water surrounding every side of the island. A shoreline fragment alone can read as either isla or playa.
The park includes a tree; forest needs a clear grove. Check that bosque/parque remains unambiguous at card size.
The falling sheet of water and ledge must dominate cascada, distinct from the fountain jet and horizontal natural water bodies.
The approved bed and hotel-room pictures contain bedding. Exclude isolated pillow/blanket versus scenes where those objects are clearly present.
Give cobija a thick warm textile fold/fringe and preserve the towel silhouette; reject any pair of nearly identical folded rectangles.
The mirror must read as reflective glass in a frame and handle. Review against the open window and spoon at 145px; revise or exclude if either answer becomes plausible.
Collar/buttons, zipper/pockets, one-piece swim shape and long trouser legs must remain clear; do not generate one garment that reasonably names another.

wordingNotes: Mexican vocabulary focus: banqueta (sidewalk), banca (bench), chamarra (jacket), cobija (blanket). Acera, banco, chaqueta and manta/frazada remain useful regional alternatives, not extra cards in this pack.
Plátano means a ripe yellow dessert banana here, not a cooked plantain. Naranja is the fruit, not the color. Fuente is a water fountain, not a source or dish.
Metro is the underground urban rail system here, not a length unit; the tunnel/platform concept and train distractor review are required.
Casco is a protective motorcycle helmet. Secadora de pelo is the handheld hair dryer, not a clothes dryer.
Pantalones names one pair of long trousers; zapato is one shoe. Montaña is a generic mountain; the existing approved illustration has two peaks.
The same text is read by all eight regional voices; regional voice labels do not imply alternate vocabulary lists.

activationPlan: Keep all level 1/2 words, media, stable IDs and progress intact.
After word approval, generate only the missing subjects and all 36×8 recordings under a separate approved level 3 batch; retain exact sources and prompts.
